name: Level Sheet Set
description: Creates a floor plan for a level, puts it on a new sheet, and tags the rooms. The everyday 'one more sheet please' job, as one button.

ribbon.tooltip: Plan + sheet + room tags for one level

inputs.name: level
inputs.label: Level
inputs.description: Level name exactly as it appears in the project browser, e.g. 00-GROUND.

inputs.name: sheetNumber
inputs.label: Sheet number
inputs.description: Must be unique. If it already exists AICon reuses that sheet instead of making a duplicate.

author: Hossam Yousef

steps.comment: The new view. Its id is reused by the next two steps.
No location given, so AICon centres it in the title block.
Rooms may not be placed yet at this stage — that must not fail the whole routine.
